text: Based on the tool output, not all of the 2021 loss was inside the pine plantation. The total loss area was 81.3 hectares, but 13.2 hectares of this loss occurred outside the mapped forest area. The remaining 68.1 hectares of loss were within the planted forest, specifically within the Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda plantation. Therefore, approximately 16% of the loss was outside the pine plantation.
